name: Raffi
why: The American trade's King of Cashmere — Raffi Shaya's family knitwear house since 1988, run by his wife and daughters under the Raffi Forever label since 2023; Acqua Cotton is the summer crown.
origin: Raffi Shaya, 1988 — an American knitwear house run by his wife and daughters under the Raffi Forever label since 2023.
opview: Wears the title the menswear trade gave it — the King of Cashmere — and since 2023, “Raffi Forever.”

notes.cashmere: called the King of Cashmere by the menswear trade itself — a holiday-season business that sells out mostly at full price
notes.comfort: washable-cashmere treatments and Acqua Cotton hand as the house competence

cities: Specialty menswear everywhere — Mitchells, Harry Rosen, Boyds · Concord MA (Blue Dry Goods)
